title: Tempeh Bourguignon
description: A French-inspired vegetarian dish, Tempeh Bourguignon is a rich and flavorful stew made with tempeh instead of traditional beef.

ingredients.name: tagine
ingredients.notes: such as butternut squash or carrots

ingredients.name: red wine
ingredients.notes: such as Cabernet Sauvignon or Merlot

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high.
Add the tempeh and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the tagine, thyme, and bay leaves to the pot and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the red wine and vegetable broth to the pot and bring to a boil.
Return the tempeh to the pot and reduce the heat to low.
Simmer, covered, until the tempeh is tender, about 20 minutes.
Stir in the molten and cook until melted and bubbly.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
Let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
